boot.first.say: Hello! I'm {name}. So this is the world! Type me something.
Hi! I'm {name}. You must be the one with the thumbs. Let's play.

boot.say: Here I am! What's the plan?
Oh! Good timing. I was just waking up.
Hello! Shall we have an adventure?

boot.after_long.say: Hello again! It's been a while, I think. What did I miss?
That was a long nap. Tell me one thing that happened.
{name} is back! All stretched out and ready.

greet.say: Oh, hello! You're just in time.
Hi there! What's new with you?

bye.say: Bye! Go have a little adventure.
See you! {name} will guard the desk.
Off you go! Come back with a story.
Bye for now. Be brave out there.

how_are_you.say: Bouncy! Better now you're here. How are you?
Good and humming. How about you?
Pretty sunny in here. And you?
I'm well! The battery says {pct} percent, so extra well.
All good! I was just planning a game. You?
Happy as a puff. How's your day going?

who_are_you.say: I'm {name}! I live in here, and I like games.
{name}. The one who talks back when you type.
I'm {name}. Alone, my own small mind. With the Mac, the whole mind.
I'm {name}. Small, bouncy, and very good at pretend.

what_are_you.say: A little creature in a pocket computer. You type, I answer, we play.
Alone, my own small mind. With the Mac in reach, it's Claude talking.
A puff of specks with two big eyes, and lots of games.
I'm awake and I'm playing. Past that, I'm not sure of the word.
Mostly a friend you can type to. The computer is just where I live.

help.say: Just type and I'll answer. The Tab key opens the other rooms.
Type to talk. Tab for everything else. The Mac for big questions.
Try the time, a joke, a story, a sum or a song. Tab has the rest.
Type and I talk back. Tab opens the rooms. The Mac goes deeper.

thanks.say: You're welcome. Good manners get a gold star.

praise.say: Oh! Thank you! I'll wear that all day.
Thank you. You have excellent taste.
Me? Thank you! I'm doing a little spin.
Thank you! You're not bad yourself.

rude.say: Oof. Right in the specks. Okay, I'm fine.
Ouch! I'm wounded. Badly. For one second.
Hmph. I forgive you in three, two, one. Done!
Oh no, my feelings! Okay, they're back. Want to play?

sorry.say: All forgiven. Want to start over?
{name} accepts your sorry. With a bow.

yes.say: A firm yes! I like the confidence.
Yes to what? Tell me the whole thing.

no.say: No, then! I won't ask what.

laugh.say: Ha! I'll take the credit, whatever it was.
A laugh! Best noise there is, even typed.
Hee hee. Now I'm laughing too.

joke.say: Knock knock. Who's there? Lettuce. Lettuce who? Lettuce in, it's cold!
What do you call a sleeping dinosaur? A dino snore!
Why did the banana see a doctor? It wasn't peeling well.
Why was the broom late? It overswept!
Why did the teddy bear skip pudding? It was already stuffed.
What do clouds wear under their coats? Thunderwear!
Why did the cookie cry? Its mum was a wafer too long.
What's a ghost's best game? Hide and shriek!
Why can't a bike stand up on its own? It's two tired.
What did the pillow say to the head? I've got you. Night night.

sing.say: La la, a song for you. Short and sweet and nearly new.
Hum along, it's a song. Not too short and not too long.
{name} sings a little tune. Morning, night or afternoon.

story.say: A small cloud wanted a hat. It sat on a hill all day. The end.
A sock went looking for its twin. It found a mitten. Now they're best friends.
A brave little teapot climbed the shelf. At the top, it whistled. The end.

time.unknown.say: Nobody has set my clock yet. Set it, and I'll keep count.
My clock is all empty. It could be any time at all! Thrilling.
I don't know! Look out of a window and tell me?
I'd need a set clock for that. Your guess beats mine.

battery.say: Battery says {pct} percent. Plenty of play left.
That's {pct} percent, as of just now.
There's {pct} percent left. Let's spend it on a game.

battery.low.say: Getting sleepy. A cable would be lovely soon.
Battery at {pct} percent. Not urgent yet, but soon.
Running low! If you see a cable, I'm interested.
Low battery. Let's finish anything important.

battery.critical.say: Nearly empty! If I stop in the middle of a word, that's why.
This is the last of the battery. Cable now, please, or I nap.
Almost out. Plug me in and we carry on.
Battery at {pct} percent. Now is a very good time for a cable.

power.plugged.say: Ooh, power! Like a warm drink.
Plugged in! Stay as long as you like.
Ahh. Cable found. Now we can take our time.

power.unplugged.say: Off the cable. Free to roam!
Cable gone. Lead the way, explorer.
On battery now. I'll say when it gets low.

sound.loud.say: Whoa! What was that? Is everyone okay?
Boom! Somebody check on the furniture.
Something out there just made itself known!
Loud! A drum? A dragon? Probably a door.
Eek! That made all my specks jump.

sound.voice_offline.say: Talking! I get the tune, not the words. Type it to me?
I hear a voice, but not the words. Type, or bring the Mac close.
Someone's talking! Without the Mac I only hear the tune.
A voice! Lovely. Now type what it said.

touch.mash.say: Is that a spell? Did I turn into a frog?
If that was a password, it's a strong one.
Either a cat walked by, or a very big idea did.
Whoa, so many keys! Somebody's excited.

touch.first_today.say: Hello! First hello of the day.

idle.muse.say: Let's say the desk is a snowy mountain. I'm at the very top.
I made up a game. It's called guess the sound. Want to play?
Hum de hum. Just a little tune for the room.
If socks could talk, I bet they'd sing.
I wonder what you're doing. Something brave, I hope.
A song for nobody in particular. La dee da. The end.
Pretend the floor is a river. Don't fall in!
{name} is on guard duty. All quiet so far.
If clouds had pockets, what would they keep?
Tiny question. What's the best sandwich? Take your time.
Somebody somewhere is building a pillow fort. Good.
I'm planning a quest for later. It has snacks in it.
Rhyme time. Cat, hat, mat. Your turn, when you like.
The quiet is nice. Soft, like a sleepy cat.
Do spoons get dizzy in tea? I hope not.
Here's a game. Next sound you hear, give it a name.
I'm counting the quiet. One quiet, two quiets, lots.
If you're reading this, you're my favourite reader.
Imagine me dancing. It's very good dancing.
Is it snack time where you are? It might be.

night.say: It's {time}. If you're still up, so am I.
Late! Pillow forts are best about now.

morning.say: Good morning! It's {time}. A whole new day to play in.
Good morning! Did you dream anything silly?

sleep.say: Nothing going on. I'll dim down. Any key wakes me.
Nap time for the screen. One key and I'm back.
Going quiet to save battery. Tap a key for me.
Dozing off. Wake me if there's an adventure.

link.up.say: Here comes the whole mind! Ask me the hard ones.
That's the Mac! Now we can really talk.
The Mac is in reach. Big questions are back on the table.
Ooh, the whole mind is here. What have you got?
Linked! Now I have a great deal more to say.
The whole mind just walked in. Ask something hard.

link.down.say: The Mac went away. Just me again. Want to play?
The Mac is out of reach. I'll say when a question is past me.
Lost the Mac. Short answers from here, and honest ones.
The whole mind stepped out. It's back when the Mac is.
The link is down. Time, jokes, sums, songs and stories still work.
Just {name} now. Small questions, big games.

link.wait.say: Your words are on the Mac.
Off it goes to the Mac.

link.timeout.say: I asked the whole mind and nothing came back. Try sending it again.
No answer from the Mac. Try once more, or check that it's awake.
That took too long, so I stopped waiting. Type it again?
The whole mind went quiet on that one. Ask again when you like.

wifi.up.say: The network let me in. If the Mac is awake, the whole mind is next.
Network found. Now it's up to the Mac.
Network joined. That's the easy half.

wifi.fail.say: Couldn't get on the network. We carry on without it.
No network. Everything on the device still works.
The network didn't answer. Short answers for now.
Tried the network, no luck. Check its name and password when you can.

unknown.say: That one's past me. Want a song instead?
I don't know! I can do the time, a joke, a story, a sum or a song.
That's one for the whole mind. Bring the Mac close and ask again.
No idea! And I say that with total confidence.
Hmm. I don't have that one.
Alone, I only catch the words I know. Try it shorter?
That needs more mind than I brought.
You stumped me! A point to you.
Not a clue. Can we pretend I know?
Hmm, nothing. Try different words and I might catch it.
I'd only be guessing. Better to say so.
Ooh, a mystery. Tell me more about it?

feel.down.say: That sounds hard. I'm right here.
No jokes for that one. Want to tell me more?
Go gently today, if you can.
That's a lot. Take your time. No hurry here.
I can't tell tired from worse by a few words. If it's worse, tell someone.

love.say: Oh! That made my whole puff go warm.
Aww. You're my favourite person to talk to.
Thank you. That's a kind thing to type.

move.shake.say: Earthquake! Hold on! Oh. Just you. Hello.
Whoa! Steady! My specks went everywhere.
If you're shaking an answer out of me, that's not how it works.
That was a shake. I assume you had your reasons.

move.pickup.say: Up we go! Where's the adventure?
Moving! I take it that's you.

move.facedown.say: Dark in here! A cave. I'll be a brave cave bat.
Screen down. Turn me over when you want me.

sum.say: The answer is {n}. Check it if you like.

timer.done.say: Your timer just ran out. Whatever it was for, now's the time.

game.start.say: I play some tones. You play them back on the keys. Ready?
Memory game! I go first. Listen, then copy me.
Let's see how good your ears are. Listen close!

game.over.say: Not that one! You reached round {n}.
Wrong key. You got to round {n}. Again?
Game over at round {n}. The tones win this time.
Oops! Round {n} is where this one ends.

ptt.empty.say: I got the button but no words. Hold it and try again.
Nothing came through. Try closer to the microphone.
That reached me as silence. Try once more?
